membership pitch

  • CURIE: gmeow:membershipPitch
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/membershipPitch
  • Category: property

The pitch value that is a member of the collection in this membership. Functional per relator: one pitch per membership.

Property shape: object property; gmeow:PitchCollectionMembership -> gmeow:PitchValue; functional
